content.text: SSRIs are the mainstay; fluoxetine (beyond age 8) and escitalopram (beyond age 12) are FDA-approved and both first-line when an antidepressant = indicated.
Cont tx for 6 mo even if Sx seem to remit (most tx 1 yr or longer); taper SSRIs gradually.

SNRIs, mirtazapine and clomipramine have more AEs (eg, HTN) and may be esp useful in treatment-resistant cases; bupropion or desipramine may be added to an SSRI to ↑efficacy; very severe depression w psychotic and/or manic Sx may need an added antipsych.

Boxed warning on all antidepressant classes: FDA's 2004 meta-analysis found a sm ↑ in suicidal ideation in children and adolescents (4% vs 2%). Venlafaxine: more self-harm events than an SSRI in adolescents w mod–severe depression.
